period_rule: Exact quarter-end contexts, current-quarter duration 65–105 days, no pre-2025 context start, explicit INR units, duplicate or conflicting context guard. Cash flow and capex can use a longer current-year reporting period and are preserved with context.
expectation: Most recent comparable reported profit plus 0.35 times median change in up to three prior releases. No historical analyst consensus or authenticated prior guidance panel.
